facts.text: Tento druh žil jen na Novém Zélandu.
facts.quote: an extinct species of large terrestrial duck that was endemic to New Zealand

facts.text: Tento druh žil v lesích, křovinách a travnatých porostech.
facts.quote: This species was present in forests, shrublands and temperate grasslands.

facts.text: Tento druh se pravděpodobně živil rostlinami, spadaným ovocem a bezobratlými.
facts.quote: was most likely a grazer and browser of vegetation, probably mixed with fallen fruit and some invertebrates

facts.text: Tento druh měl silně zmenšená křídla a pravděpodobně neuměl létat.
facts.quote: The wings were much reduced however, and it seems that flight was lost relatively quickly
